# CERN Headquarters and Foundation Year

## Overview

CERN was founded in 1954. [1][2][3] One source reports that CERN's headquarters are located in Meyrin, a western suburb of Geneva, on the France–Switzerland border. [3]

## Sources

1. [CERN | Organization, European Research Infrastructure](https://groundingpage.com/facts/cern) — groundingpage.com, published 2026-10-10, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [https://www.britannica.com/topic/CERN](https://www.britannica.com/topic/CERN) — britannica.com, fetched 2026-10-31
3. [CERN - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CERN) — wikipedia.org, published 2002-02-03, fetched 2026-10-31
